book.name: Romans
book.title: ROMANS PAUL AN FEF IGAYAM ROME YANGAN AURIS

content: Omi Men Taim Tuam Wonigurubabanai Mes
Omi sanamui nan orot iyafan an baitutum samisamin aurin on; men wonisisiweiai mes, asir wonboai mom ato on toun an gogoi aifan nanaba inafour not ta ta inbinonoten aurin on men wonagam wonawur mes.
Orot tani an baitutum iyau nanaba on arimon siu magis magis inam, baise orot iyafan an baitutum samisamin on men masono inam on.

Orot iyafan siu magis magis arimon inam on men inmisir toun orot turan ato men masono yam aurin on wabin inyeirai mes, mat orot ato men masono yam on men inmisir turan ato siu magis magis yam aurin on inigigimai mes, yabin God on orot aurin on ibasitai nono.

woit, om on men on orot jever tani an agirotin unigurubabanai mes. Keriso on On an Bada, On ekesin mom on ininonotai mamaba on bobo obin ifour tiwag o men bobo obin ifour tiwag. Ato on arimon bobo obin inafour tiwag, yabin Bada on arimon fofonin aurin iniyamai bobo obin inafour.

Orot tani enonosin ra kaitamom on gagamin bag men ra fani ba; ato orot tani enonosin ra tutufin engon on fofonis wat. Orot kakaita kakaita on tous sinsagob tiwag osi asi bainonot on obin mamaba sebinonotis min on dura bag.

Iyai iyafan enonosin ra kaitamom on gagamin bag men ra fani ba, on nanaba enonosin min on Bada ebifain; iyai iyafan siu magis magis yam on min Bada ebifain, yabin on siu aurin on God ebikakaiwai. Iyai iyafan men egogoi masono inam on min Bada ebifain, ato on God ebikakaiwai.
Ot men iyafan tani on toun ekesin aurin wat emama on, ot men iyafan tani toun ekesin aurin wat erarabob on;
ot yawasit tamama on, Bada aurin on tamama, ato tanarab on, ot Bada aurin on tanarab. Mamaba ot tamama o tararabob, ot on Bada ebinoanai.
Yabin Keriso irabob ato imisir men onai sabu yawasis semama o serarabob on osi asi Bada.
On mes omi aibo mes taim tuam wobigurubabanai? Ato omi aibo mes taim tuam wobigigimai? Ot sabu engon tutufin min arimon God nanai tantawar On inigurubabanit.
Yabin God an dura buk amonai sigayam, Bada iyau,

content.text: “Dura bag Yau on God Yawasiu amama, sabu engon tutufin arimon Yau nawui sindas sinrou, a sabu engon tutufin arimon dura sinkurereb sinau, Yau on God.”

content: Ot sabu engon tutufin on arimon ati bobo mamaba tafofour aurin on ot kakaita kakaita on God taniyafotai.
Omi Taim Tuam Men Woniyamai Inafeu Mes
On mes ot tuturat mat tabigurubabanit bonen on tanikirir. Baise omi atonio nanaba wotinonotim wotau: Ot men bobo aifan tani taniyamai tait tuat inafeu o inbokomas mes.
Yau on Bada Iesu rui waikaita on ebiyameu yau asagob dura bag, men siu aifan tani on kakafot on; baise orot iyafan ebitutum sawar on kakafot, ato on sawar min enat on orot aurin on kakafot emamatar.
Om siu mamaba yam aurin taim tuam ebikomasai on, om on men nuabo an yawasai efofour on. Keriso on ato orot aurin irabob ato om men siu yam aurin on unikomasai mes!
Omi ami yawas on men woniyamai aifan wononosin on obin ato bayu am aurin, ato sabu fani senonosin on komasin ato on aurin on dura komasis sinikakafun.
Yabin God an Baiaiwab aurin on men ato siu am tom aurin on, baise on on yawas totorin wat, tuf a yasisir wat auris, osi yawas on Ayu Kakafotin emon ebitet.
Ato iyai iyafan on etaiai Keriso ebiagirai on God ebiyasisirai a on bobo aifan efofour on sabu sebidura bagai.
On mes ot on ra fufur tanafourtobon osi yawas ato tuf sibo senat on auris on tanabo, a on yawas on ot inibaisit tuturat mat tankufaiwarit bonen.

Omi men woniyamai ato siu magis magis tam aurin on God an bobo aifan ifofour on wonikomasai mes. Siu engon tutufin on tanam, baise men iyobin siu fani wonam on nan arimon woniyamai orot jever inbokomas.
Omi bobo obin wonfofour on men masono wonam, omi men sareu wine wontoman, o men bobo aifan tani woniyamai taim tuam inbokomas mes.

Omi ami baitutumai on atonio siu am tom aurin a ami bainonotai nan wonbotanen omi toum aurim a God aurin wat. Yasisir on ato orot aurin, on enonosin on bobo obin wat siu am tom aurin ifour ato gibui men innos on bobo komasin ifour on!

Baise on siu aifan yam ato ebinonotai on eta isarar, God on on orot ebimakiai ato siu yam aurin on, yabin on an bainonot on men baitutumai etatawar on. Ot men baitutumai nan bobo ta ta tafofour min on bokomas tabiyamai.
